basic_info.description: Step into Victorian Modern living: a big, bright and sunny top floor condo, a gorgeous Painted Lady with three generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The primary bedroom features a charming Juliette balcony overlooking the lively Wiggle bike lane (so fun!) and an entire wall of custom closets: no more fighting for hanger space! The middle bedroom is bathed in natural light from the huge skylight. The updated kitchen boasts stunning new custom cabinets, quartz countertops, a large gas range, and a center island perfect for casual dining or gathering with friends. Enter the sunny dining room which leads directly to the rear steps and a lush, shared garden. The living room features original wainscoting, built-in cabinetry, crown molding, and a decorative fireplace. One of the two full bathrooms has been recently renovated and includes a stacked washer and dryer for added convenience.    Did we mention PARKING? Yes! independent parking, a large storage space, and an additional stacked laundry in the garage are all yours! Located in the hot, hot, hot Lower Haight, just steps from the Divisadero Corridor, BiRite, NoPa, Duboce Park, Alamo Square, on the Wiggle, and Muni. Don't miss! Once the home of famed Cuban artist Carlos Cancio, the owners kept his exterior color scheme!
